parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=10 experiment (val_bpb 0.997983). Scaling depth from 8 to 10 provided a solid improvement over my previous best (1.006470). Now that we know higher capacity is beneficial, I will test if reducing the batch size to increase optimizer steps further improves convergence within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 at DEPTH=10 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute training budget.
